In summary, our research is concerned with

the problem of providing recommendations for products in e-commerce environments, where a large number of products and customers make it very hard for a customer to find the right product for his or her needs.
the problem of providing personalized recommendations to users in e-commerce environments.
developing a methodology to improve the quality and performance of collaborative filtering-based recommender systems by using Web usage mining and a product taxonomy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed methodology is an effective and promising approach for enhancing the performance of current CF recommender systems.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a recommendation methodology based upon the Web Usage Mining and Product Taxonomy.

we proposed a new collaborative filtering methodology based on Web Usage Mining (Web Usage Mining is a process to discover interesting knowledge from Web log files) to enhance the recommendation performance.
we propose a new methodology to improve the quality of recommendations and system performance of current collaborative filtering-based recommendation methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a taxonomy to reduce the dimensions of a user-item matrix, which is the basis for collaborative filtering, is a useful way to reduce the complexity of the recommendation problem.
